records.summary: Firsthand E1 hiker reached Böne at 08:00; Böne kyrka was locked and churchyard water was signed not drinkable. Heavy rain and cold conditions were noted. The day was mostly road walking with off-road walking around Årås/Vållern.

records.title: dogs Livestock Private Land
records.summary: Ulricehamn local ordinance requires dogs to be leashed on public/equivalent places such as hiking trails and beaches and dog waste to be picked up. Årås reserve forbids unleashed dogs; Kärnås forbids loose dogs; Knätte visit page shows dog restriction. The route crosses rural farmland and villages, and 2024 photo evidence confirms livestock near/on the trail. Keep dogs leashed, close gates, avoid livestock stress and avoid damaging crops.

records.title: road And Surface Hazards
records.summary: This is a road-heavy easy stage: asphalt out of Böne, then smaller gravel/unsealed roads through rural landscape. Expect mixed road walking, limited services and weather exposure. A 2025 E1 field report encountered heavy rain/cold and used a Jogen changing-room building for dry shelter.

records.title: water Safety
records.summary: Do not treat Böne kyrka as potable water. Varpaledet/Jogen is bathing water, not drinking water; 2025 samples were reported as tjänligt/no bloom but 2026 bathing-season samples were not found on 2026-04-29. Avoid bathing if water is visibly cloudy/discolored from algal bloom. Boat/fishing rules around bathing jetties include no boat mooring at bathing-place jetties, no boat traffic within at least 50 m of installed bathing jetty and no fishing at/near bathing places during May-September.
